principles: one finding has one accountable owner and one canonical remediation path
evidence is bound to an immutable source SHA and candidate identity
a passing technical check cannot substitute for a missing business outcome
production authority remains separate from repository acceptance

gates.name: Business / Product
gates.question: Does the change solve an approved customer or operator problem through a canonical Golden Journey?

gates.name: Architecture / Data
gates.question: Does the change preserve one aggregate authority, one mutable writer and one migration chain?

gates.name: Security / Privacy
gates.question: Are capabilities, data purpose, PII lifecycle and supply-chain boundaries fail closed?

gates.name: Release / Runtime
gates.question: Is the exact candidate reproducible, observable, recoverable and safe to activate only for the approved capability?

gates.name: Production Outcome
gates.question: After activation, do real customer outcomes meet governed targets without hidden harm or silent failure?
